bloodlines.arcana: Increase the save DC of every spell you cast with the electricity or sonic descriptor by 1.

powers.name: Thunderstaff
powers.summary: Give a touched weapon shock for half your sorcerer level in rounds; at 9th level grant shocking burst for half the duration. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Stormchild
powers.summary: Gain electricity and sonic resistance 5 and reduce wind severity by one step; at 9th reduce it by two steps and gain blindsense 60 feet through weather concealment.

powers.name: Thunderbolt
powers.summary: Call a 5-foot-radius lightning stroke within 120 feet for 1d6 damage per sorcerer level, half electricity and half sonic, deafening creatures that fail their Reflex save.

powers.name: Ride the Lightning
powers.summary: Once per day become living lightning for rounds equal to your sorcerer level, moving up to ten times your speed through creatures and damaging them as Thunderbolt.

powers.name: Storm Lord
powers.summary: Gain immunity to deafness, stunning, and wind effects, weather blindsight 120 feet, and once per day absorb an electricity or sonic attack to heal.

bloodlines.arcana: After casting a personal-range spell, gain natural armor equal to its spell level for 1d4 rounds; this does not stack with other natural armor.

powers.name: Tanglevine
powers.summary: Create a 15-foot animated vine for one disarm, steal, or trip maneuver using sorcerer level plus Charisma modifier as CMB. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Photosynthesis
powers.summary: Reduce your need for food and sleep as a ring of sustenance and gain +2 racial saves against poison and sleep, increasing to +4 at 9th level.

powers.name: Massmorph
powers.summary: Alter plant growth or transform willing creatures into trees; at levels 15 and 20 use progressively stronger plant shapes, with creature transformation once per day.

powers.name: Rooting
powers.summary: Root into the ground for minutes per day to gain +4 natural armor, +10 CMD against forced movement, tremorsense 30 feet, and fast healing 1 while reducing speed to 5 feet.

powers.name: Shepherd of the Trees
powers.summary: Gain +4 natural armor, tremorsense 30 feet, and immunity to paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning.
